subject: Human Body
title: Arthritis
description: A micro-lesson that makes Arthritis usable.

hook.text: Over 350 million people worldwide have arthritis. It's the leading cause of disability in adults.

buildup.text: Osteoarthritis wears away cartilage over time. Rheumatoid arthritis is the immune system attacking joints.

discovery.text: Osteoarthritis hits weight-bearing joints: knees, hips, and spine. It worsens with age and overuse.

twist.text: Rheumatoid arthritis can strike at any age, even children. The body destroys its own joint lining.

climax.text: There's no cure for either type. Treatment focuses on slowing damage and managing pain.

punchline.text: Two diseases, one name. Both steal movement.

quiz.question: What causes rheumatoid arthritis?
options: Normal wear and tear on joints
The immune system attacking joint tissue
